Starting solids is exciting. But it's also completely overwhelming.

What foods should you start with? How do you introduce allergens safely? What does a baby-friendly family meal actually look like? How do you know if you're moving too fast — or not fast enough?

Most parents go into their baby's first month of solids without a clear plan. They end up repeating the same few foods, second-guessing every mealtime, and spending way too much time Googling at 11pm.

It doesn't have to be that way.

A Simple Plan for Your Baby's First Four Weeks of Solids

The Baby's First Month Meal Plan walks you through your baby's first four weeks of starting solids with a clear, day-by-day guide — so you always know what to serve next, how to serve it safely, and how to include your baby in family meals from the very beginning.

Using our Family Meals from the Start® approach, your baby learns to eat real food alongside the rest of the family — no separate cooking, no pouches, no guesswork.

Your Baby's First Month of Solids Shapes Their Relationship With Food

The foods your baby is exposed to during this window help determine their comfort with new textures, their willingness to try new things, and their eating habits for years to come. Research shows that early and repeated exposure to a variety of foods and allergens supports healthy eating habits and may help reduce picky eating.

But most parents start solids without a clear plan — and end up repeating the same few foods or feeling unsure what to serve next. This guide makes sure you start strong.
